title: 1 · Shares, explained from zero
steps: What a share actually is

A share is a tiny slice of ownership in a real company. Own a share of Woolworths and you own a (very small) piece of every store, truck and checkout. If the company grows more valuable, your slice does too. What the ASX is

The Australian Securities Exchange — the marketplace where those slices are bought and sold, open weekdays 10am–4pm Sydney time. Every listed company has a short code called a ticker: BHP, WOW, CBA. The app always shows the code first because it's how the market names things.
How you'd actually buy one

Through a broker — an app or website that places orders for you, like a real-estate agent for shares. THIS app is not a broker: it never buys or sells anything and never touches your money. It's your research desk. You can practise here with pretend money for as long as you like before any real broker is involved.
Where a price comes from

Nobody 'sets' share prices. A price is simply the last amount a real buyer and a real seller agreed on. When more people want to buy than sell, buyers must offer more and the price drifts up; when sellers outnumber buyers, it drifts down. That's the whole machine. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><text x='60' y='14' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>MORE BUYERS</text><rect x='22' y='22' width='11' height='26' rx='2' fill='#4ade80' /><rect x='38' y='22' width='11' height='26' rx='2' fill='#4ade80' /><rect x='54' y='22' width='11' height='26' rx='2' fill='#4ade80' /><rect x='70' y='22' width='11' height='26' rx='2' fill='#4ade80' /><rect x='86' y='22' width='11' height='26' rx='2' fill='#4ade80' /><rect x='102' y='22' width='11' height='26' rx='2' fill='#4ade80' /><text x='60' y='62' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>fewer sellers</text><rect x='38' y='68' width='11' height='18' rx='2' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='54' y='68' width='11' height='18' rx='2' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='70' y='68' width='11' height='18' rx='2' fill='#54627f' /><path d='M150 54 L188 54 L188 46 L206 58 L188 70 L188 62 L150 62 Z' fill='#f5c84c'/><polyline points='222,78 250,66 270,52 292,34' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='2.2'/><circle cx='292' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#4ade80'/><text x='226' y='20' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>price drifts UP</text><text x='226' y='92' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>flip the crowds and it drifts down</text></svg>
Why prices move every day

Company news, profits, rumours, interest rates, the general mood, and big funds shuffling their holdings. Most shares barely move most days — which is exactly why the unusual days, the ones this app hunts for, are worth a look.
End-of-day, in plain words

This app works from each day's CLOSING numbers — like reading the final score after the match instead of watching every kick live. It's calmer, cheaper and better suited to research and learning. It is not a minute-by-minute trading screen, and it never pretends to be. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polyline points='14,60 40,48 62,66 90,42 118,58 142,36 170,52 196,44 224,56 250,40 276,50 296,46' fill='none' stroke='#54627f' stroke-width='1.8'/><circle cx='296' cy='46' r='5' fill='#f5c84c'/><line x1='296' y1='12' x2='296' y2='88' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='3 3'/><text x='292' y='98' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='end' font-family='sans-serif'>the CLOSE</text><text x='14' y='16' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>the noisy trading day…</text><text x='14' y='98' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>this app reads the final score — calm, cheap, ideal for research</text></svg>

quiz.q: What is a share, really?
a: A loan you give a company
A tiny slice of ownership in a real company
A bet that only pays out if the price rises
quiz.why: Own a share and you own a piece of the company — its trucks, brands and profits. That's why the company's fortunes move your money.

quiz.q: Where does a share's price come from?
a: The ASX sets it every morning
It's simply the last price a real buyer and a real seller agreed on
quiz.why: Nobody 'sets' prices. Every price you see is just the most recent deal struck between two people.

quiz.q: What does 'end-of-day data' mean?
a: The app reads each day's closing numbers — like the final score after the match
Only data from the last hour
quiz.why: This app is a calm research desk, not a live trading screen — and it never pretends otherwise.

quiz.q: A company you own shares in pays a dividend. What is that?
a: A refund of part of what you paid for the shares
Interest the ASX pays for holding shares
A cash share of the company's profits, paid to owners
quiz.why: Dividends come from the company's own profits — owners get a slice. Not every company pays one; growing companies often reinvest instead.

title: 2 · Volume — the app's secret ingredient
steps: What volume is

Volume is how many shares changed hands today. Price tells you WHAT happened; volume tells you HOW MANY people were part of it. One without the other is half a story. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polyline points='12,42 60,44 108,41 156,43 204,40 252,42 300,39' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='2'/><text x='14' y='30' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>price: barely moved — says almost nothing</text><rect x='18' y='79' width='14' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='51' y='77' width='14' height='11' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='84' y='80' width='14' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='117' y='78' width='14' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='150' y='79' width='14' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='183' y='78' width='14' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='216' y='80' width='14' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='249' y='42' width='14' height='46' rx='1.5' fill='#f5c84c' /><text x='232' y='34' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>volume SHOUTS</text><text x='14' y='99' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>same flat price — but four times the shares changed hands</text></svg>
Why it beats price alone

A share rising 5% on a trickle of volume is a whisper — a couple of small trades can do that. The same rise on three times its normal volume is a crowd pushing through the door. Volume is the app's lie detector for price moves. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><text x='80' y='14' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>+4% on a quiet day</text><polyline points='16,52 50,46 84,40 118,34' fill='none' stroke='#54627f' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='24' y='81' width='10' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='46' y='80' width='10' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='68' y='81' width='10' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='90' y='80' width='10' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><text x='240' y='14' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>+4% on a HEAVY day</text><polyline points='186,52 220,46 254,40 288,34' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='2.4'/><rect x='194' y='70' width='10' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80' /><rect x='216' y='62' width='10' height='26' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80' /><rect x='238' y='56' width='10' height='32' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80' /><rect x='260' y='48' width='10' height='40' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80' /><text x='160' y='99' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>same move — the crowded one carries far more meaning</text></svg>
Everything is compared to the share's OWN normal

A million shares traded is enormous for a small miner and a quiet morning for a bank. So the app never uses raw numbers — it compares today against that share's own 3-month average. '+200%' always means 'three times ITS normal', whoever it is. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='14' y='78' width='11' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='38' y='77' width='11' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='62' y='76' width='11' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='86' y='68' width='11' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#f5c84c' /><rect x='110' y='62' width='11' height='24' rx='1.5' fill='#f5c84c' /><rect x='134' y='58' width='11' height='28' rx='1.5' fill='#f5c84c' /><rect x='158' y='54' width='11' height='32' rx='1.5' fill='#f5c84c' /><rect x='182' y='74' width='11' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='206' y='76' width='11' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='230' y='75' width='11' height='11' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='254' y='77' width='11' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='278' y='76' width='11' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f' /><polyline points='14,58 62,56 110,55 158,52 206,44 254,32 300,20' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='2.2'/><text x='96' y='16' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>volume wakes FIRST…</text><text x='212' y='16' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>…price follows</text><text x='14' y='99' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>the app hunts these early-volume days for you</text></svg>
The footprints the app hunts

Steady up-days on above-normal volume (someone keeps buying — the accumulation footprint). Heavy volume on a falling price (someone big is leaving — distribution). A record volume day (something happened — find out what). Every scan in this app is a different way of spotting one of these footprints.
Volume confirms — or denies — a price move

A 5% rise on triple normal volume means real money agreed with the move. The same 5% on a tiny fraction of normal volume might be one small trade in a thin market — much weaker evidence. Before trusting any move, glance at the Vol Surge column: the move and the volume should tell the same story.
What counts as 'above average'?

Every 'above average' in this app measures against the share's recent 3-month average — the same number printed on its card — not some ancient mean from a year ago. A share that was famous and loud last year but quiet lately is judged against today's normal, so a genuine surge counts even if the distant past was bigger. And if a streak ever looks wrong to you, tap the Volume-streak row in the deep dive: the app will show you the exact stored days, the average it used, and a live recount. It would rather show its working than be trusted blindly.

quiz.q: A share rises 5% on THREE TIMES its normal volume. Compared with the same rise on tiny volume, that is…
a: More meaningful — a whole crowd was involved
quiz.why: Volume is the lie detector for price moves: a rise with a crowd behind it means far more than a whisper.

quiz.q: Why does the app compare today's volume with each share's OWN average?
a: Because a million shares is enormous for one company and a quiet morning for another
To make the numbers look smaller
It doesn't — it uses raw numbers
quiz.why: '+200%' always means 'three times ITS normal', whoever the share is. Raw volume numbers mean nothing on their own.

quiz.q: A share rises 5% on volume 300% above average. Another rises 5% on volume 80% BELOW average. What's the difference?
a: The first move has real money behind it; the second is thin and easily reversed
The second is better — quieter is safer
quiz.why: Volume is conviction. A move made by lots of real buying is far more meaningful than the same % made on a handful of trades.

steps: Start in Starter view

What ? and '— none' mean

A ? means 'not calculated yet' — the data for that share is still being prepared, give it a moment. '— none' in the Signals column means nothing unusual happened for that share today, which is the normal, healthy answer for most shares on most days. Neither is an error.
Hover anything you don't understand

Every column heading, tag and button explains itself in a sentence when you hover (or long-press on a phone). The app never expects you to memorise jargon — if something doesn't explain itself, that's a bug, not your fault.
Finding your way: grouped scans & report windows

The left panel groups everything by job — 📌 Pinned favourites at the top (Market Pulse, Top 20, Best Evidence), then ⚡ Act today, 🧭 Build a view and 📊 Compare & study. Reports open in their own window with two size buttons in the footer: ⛶ Max fills the app, 🖥 Full screen takes over the whole monitor (Esc brings everything back).

quiz.q: '— none' in the Signals column means…
a: Nothing unusual happened for that share today — the normal, healthy answer
quiz.why: Flags are rare on purpose. Most shares, most days, have nothing unusual to report — that's what makes the flags meaningful when they appear.

quiz.q: A ? in a column means…
a: Not calculated yet — the data for that share is still preparing
quiz.why: Give it a moment, or check the yellow status line — the app always says what it's doing.

quiz.q: Where do the three most-used scans live?
a: 📌 Pinned at the top of the grouped sidebar
quiz.why: Market Pulse, Top 20 and Best Evidence sit pinned at the top of the sidebar so your daily routine is always two taps away.

title: 4 · Staying safe: risk, scams and honest expectations
steps: The only money rule that matters

Never put in money you can't afford to lose completely. Small companies really can halve in a week, and occasionally go to zero. Decide the amount BEFORE you look at any exciting chart, not after. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='12' y='22' width='120' height='64' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='72' y='16' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>your whole account</text><rect x='20' y='66' width='104' height='14' rx='2' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='20' y='48' width='104' height='14' rx='2' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='20' y='30' width='104' height='14' rx='2' fill='#54627f' /><rect x='150' y='30' width='44' height='50' rx='3' fill='#f5c84c' /><text x='172' y='92' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>one buy</text><path d='M206 52 L232 52 L232 44 L250 56 L232 68 L232 60 L206 60 Z' fill='#f87171'/><text x='282' y='50' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>if the stop</text><text x='282' y='60' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>hits: lose</text><text x='282' y='72' fill='#f87171' font-size='10' font-weight='800' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>~1-2%</text><text x='14' y='99' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>small parcels + a stop = no single share can hurt the account</text></svg>
Diversification in one sentence

Don't put everything in one share — spread it across several, so one disaster can't sink you. Even professionals who research full-time get individual picks wrong; their survival trick is simply not betting everything on one. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='10' y='14' width='300' height='80' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='24' y='32' fill='#f87171' font-size='12' font-weight='800' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>✗</text><text x='42' y='32' fill='#f87171' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>guaranteed returns</text><text x='150' y='32' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>— nobody honest promises them</text><text x='24' y='52' fill='#f87171' font-size='12' font-weight='800' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>✗</text><text x='42' y='52' fill='#f87171' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>act NOW pressure</text><text x='148' y='52' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>— urgency is the salesman talking</text><text x='24' y='72' fill='#f87171' font-size='12' font-weight='800' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>✗</text><text x='42' y='72' fill='#f87171' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>strangers with tips</text><text x='148' y='72' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>— why would they share a real edge?</text><text x='24' y='89' fill='#4ade80' font-size='12' font-weight='800' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>✓</text><text x='42' y='89' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>your own research, in your own time</text></svg>
How to spot a pump-and-dump

If a stranger online is very excited about a tiny share, assume they bought it BEFORE telling you and plan to sell into the rise they're creating. The app's 🥇 Vol record and 🚨 Sharp Mover flags often light up on exactly these shares — remember a flag is a reason to CHECK, and sometimes a reason to run. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polyline points='12,78 40,70 62,80 92,62 116,72 146,54 170,64 200,48 226,58 254,40 280,50 304,34' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='2.2'/><circle cx='92' cy='62' r='0'/><line x1='56' y1='86' x2='66' y2='86' stroke='#f87171' stroke-width='3'/><line x1='110' y1='78' x2='122' y2='78' stroke='#f87171' stroke-width='3'/><line x1='164' y1='70' x2='176' y2='70' stroke='#f87171' stroke-width='3'/><line x1='220' y1='64' x2='232' y2='64' stroke='#f87171' stroke-width='3'/><text x='14' y='16' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>a REAL account grows like this — sawtooth, not a straight line</text><text x='56' y='98' fill='#f87171' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>the dips are normal, planned-for, and survivable</text></svg>
What this app will never do

Predict the future, tell you to buy or sell, or know something the market doesn't. Estimates here are labelled as estimates; confirmed filings carry a ✓; the report card even grades the app's own signals honestly. Anything promising more than that — anywhere, from anyone — deserves suspicion.
Practice first, always

Use the practice portfolio with pretend money for at least a month before any real broker. It charges pretend brokerage, tracks your win rate honestly, and shows you the price NOW versus where you sold. The lessons practice losses teach cost nothing — the real ones aren't so generous.
What end-of-day data can NEVER tell you

The app sees prices and volumes after the market closes. It cannot see broker order books, off-market deals, tomorrow's announcements, or why somebody bought. Every flag is an educated estimate from the footprint — a reason to research, never proof. If a claim can't be checked in the official links (📰 news, 🏛 announcements, filings), treat it as a guess.

quiz.q: The only money rule that matters:
a: Never invest money you can't afford to lose completely
quiz.why: Small companies really can halve in a week. Decide your amount BEFORE looking at any exciting chart.

quiz.q: A stranger online is very excited about a tiny share. The safest assumption is…
a: They bought BEFORE telling you and plan to sell into the rise they're creating
quiz.why: That's a pump-and-dump. The app's 🥇 Vol record and 🚨 Sharp Mover flags often light up on exactly these shares — a flag is a reason to check, sometimes a reason to run.

quiz.q: Which of these will this app NEVER do?
a: Tell you to buy or sell
quiz.why: Every number here is a reason to research — never advice, never a prediction. Anything promising more deserves suspicion.

quiz.q: The app flags '🕵️ Informed?' on a share. What does that prove?
a: Someone with inside knowledge definitely bought
Nothing is proven — the price/volume footprint merely LOOKS like informed buying; verify via announcements
quiz.why: Footprint flags are estimates from public end-of-day data. Only official filings are facts — the flag tells you where to look, not what happened.

title: 5 · Getting started
steps: New to shares entirely?

Lessons 1–4 assume nothing at all — what a share actually is, how prices get made, why volume matters, and how to stay safe. Start there and everything in this app makes far more sense. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='12' y='30' width='84' height='42' rx='7' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='1.6'/><text x='54' y='48' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='10' font-weight='800' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>1 · LOAD</text><text x='54' y='62' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>todays market</text><path d='M100 48 L112 48 L112 42 L126 51 L112 60 L112 54 L100 54 Z' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='130' y='30' width='84' height='42' rx='7' fill='none' stroke='#60a5fa' stroke-width='1.6'/><text x='172' y='48' fill='#60a5fa' font-size='10' font-weight='800' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>2 · SCAN</text><text x='172' y='62' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>find the unusual</text><path d='M218 48 L230 48 L230 42 L244 51 L230 60 L230 54 L218 54 Z' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='248' y='30' width='62' height='42' rx='7' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='1.6'/><text x='279' y='48' fill='#4ade80' font-size='10' font-weight='800' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>3 ·</text><text x='279' y='62' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9' font-weight='800' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>PRACTISE</text><text x='14' y='16' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>the whole app is this loop, once a day:</text><text x='14' y='94' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>ten minutes with the evening numbers is plenty</text></svg>
What this app is

Insight Trading is an end-of-day share screener. It reads the day's prices and volumes for a whole exchange and highlights shares worth a closer look. It is a research tool, NOT financial advice — it never tells you what to buy or sell.
Starter view first

When you open the app you're in Starter view — a clean screen with one 'Load today's shares' button and a few big cards: Today's top scorers, Who's being quietly bought, What's moving on big volume, and My portfolio. Tap a card and it runs that report. This is all most people need. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='12' y='24' width='88' height='52' rx='7' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='1.6'/><text x='56' y='44' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>paper account</text><text x='56' y='58' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>pretend money</text><path d='M104 46 L118 46 L118 40 L132 50 L118 60 L118 54 L104 54 Z' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='136' y='24' width='88' height='52' rx='7' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='1.6'/><text x='180' y='44' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>confidence</text><text x='180' y='58' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>months of practice</text><path d='M228 46 L242 46 L242 40 L256 50 L242 60 L242 54 L228 54 Z' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='260' y='24' width='50' height='52' rx='7' fill='none' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/><text x='285' y='44' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>real</text><text x='285' y='58' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>much later</text><text x='14' y='92' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>this app never touches real money — the last box is your choice, elsewhere, someday</text></svg>
Load some data

Two ways: press 📊 Demo data (here in training) to explore with sample shares, or tap ⚡ Load to pull today's real market — it comes straight from your server, no key needed. Once there's saved data on the device, the app loads it instantly every time you open — signals and all — and fetches today's fresh prices quietly in the background.
Read one row
Each row is one share: its code, price, today's % change, volume vs its own average, streaks, and rating columns. Hover any column header (dashed purple) to learn what it means.
The golden rule
Every number here is an ESTIMATE from price and volume. A high score means 'worth researching', never 'good buy'. Always verify with the company's official announcements before doing anything.

quiz.q: What is Insight Trading?
a: A broker that buys shares for you
An end-of-day research tool that highlights shares worth a closer look
quiz.why: It reads the day's closing prices and volumes and points your torch — the decisions, and the broker, are separate.

quiz.q: With saved data on the device, opening the app…
a: Shows your market with signals within seconds, then fetches fresh prices in the background
Re-downloads the whole market from scratch
quiz.why: Loading is automatic now — saved data appears instantly and today's prices arrive quietly behind it.

quiz.q: What's the very first thing to do in a new session?
a: Pick your exchange and press ⚡ Load so today's data is in
Buy something quickly before prices move
quiz.why: Everything in the app works on the day's loaded data. Exchange → Load → then scans, filters and reports.

title: 6 · Starter vs Advanced view
steps: Two ways to use the app

At the top you'll see a 🙂 Starter / ⚙ Advanced switch. Starter view keeps things calm — just the load button and a handful of big cards. Advanced view opens the full toolkit: every scan, all the filters, presets and settings. The app remembers whichever you last used. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='10' y='14' width='140' height='72' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='80' y='30' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='10' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>STARTER</text><text x='80' y='46' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>load button</text><text x='80' y='58' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>+ a handful of</text><text x='80' y='70' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>plain-English cards</text><rect x='170' y='14' width='140' height='72' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#60a5fa' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='240' y='30' fill='#60a5fa' font-size='10' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>ADVANCED</text><text x='240' y='46' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>every scan</text><text x='240' y='58' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>filters + presets</text><text x='240' y='70' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>the full table</text></svg>
What Starter view gives you

The essential reports as plain-English cards, split into two groups. TODAY'S MARKET: 🏆 Today's top scorers, 🎯 Who's being quietly bought, 🔥 What's moving on big volume, 📊 Market today (a breadth snapshot of the whole market) and ↩️ Recovery watch (fallen shares stabilising on volume). MY LISTS: 💼 My portfolio, ⭐ My watchlist and 🔬 Research further. Cards that need market data stay dimmed until you load; after loading, small count badges show how many shares each scan would find right now. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 104' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><text x='12' y='14' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='8' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>TODAY’S MARKET</text><rect x='10' y='20' width='94' height='34' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='57' y='34' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>Top scorers</text><text x='57' y='46' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>today</text><rect x='112' y='20' width='94' height='34' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='159' y='34' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>Quietly being</text><text x='159' y='46' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>bought</text><rect x='214' y='20' width='94' height='34' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='261' y='34' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>Moving on</text><text x='261' y='46' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>big volume</text><line x1='57' y1='54' x2='57' y2='68' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='51,64 59,68 51,72' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='10' y='70' width='180' height='28' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='100' y='86' fill='#4ade80' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>tap a card → tidy pop-up list</text><text x='255' y='88' fill='#54627f' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>no table needed</text></svg>
Loading is automatic now

With saved data on the device, the app loads it the moment it opens — the full market with signals ready, no internet needed — then fetches today's fresh prices in the background. If the live list ever comes back incomplete on a bad-network day, the app keeps your fuller saved view and says so. The 'Get today's fresh prices' button is for forcing a refresh yourself.
Choosing a saved market

If you've downloaded more than one exchange (say ASX and NYSE), tapping '📂 Load your saved shares' asks which market to load — each is stored separately and never mixes. With just one saved, it loads straight away.
What's changed since last time

With saved history, Starter view shows a 🔔 What's changed card — the shares that started moving (accumulating, surging on volume or climbing in score) since your last visit, watchlist shares starred. It shows the top 5 with a ▼ Show all link. Tap any ROW and it expands with quick actions: 🖨 open its report, ⭐ add/remove watchlist, 💼 practice buy, 🔬 flag for research — plus its live price, today's move and volume vs normal. Tapping the share CODE jumps straight to the report.
Tapping a report card

In Starter view each card opens in its own pop-up window: 🏆 Today's top scorers, 🎯 Who's being quietly bought, 🔥 What's moving on big volume. You get a tidy list — tap any share code (the printer icon) in it to open that share's full report, right inside the app.
When to go Advanced

Switch to ⚙ Advanced when you want the extra scans (Sharp Mover, Unusual Activity, All Signals), the filters to narrow the list, live-load presets, or the setup and data settings. Nothing is lost in Starter view — it's just tucked away. The small '⚙ More tools & settings →' link jumps you there too.
Which should I use?

Start in Starter. Move to Advanced once you want to fine-tune what you're looking for. You can flip between them any time — there's no wrong choice, and your watchlist, portfolio and data are the same in both. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 84' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='20' y='24' width='110' height='40' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='75' y='42' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>start in</text><text x='75' y='55' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>STARTER</text><line x1='134' y1='38' x2='182' y2='38' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='176,34 184,38 176,42' fill='#8fa0c9'/><line x1='182' y1='52' x2='134' y2='52' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='128,48 136,52 128,56' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='186' y='24' width='114' height='40' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#60a5fa' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='243' y='42' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>flip any time</text><text x='243' y='55' fill='#60a5fa' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>ADVANCED</text><text x='160' y='78' fill='#54627f' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>no wrong choice - nothing is lost switching</text></svg>
Little helpers around the cards

A 🔍 search box above the cards appears once data is loaded — type a code or name to filter. A red banner tells you when the ASX is closed (data shown is from the last session), and under the cards a line shows how many shares are loaded and how fresh the data is. Reports open in pop-ups you can close with the ✕ in the corner or by swiping down on a phone.

quiz.q: Starter view is…
a: The essentials as plain-English cards — all most people ever need
quiz.why: Starter is a complete way to use the app, not a demo. Advanced just adds every scan, filter and setting.

quiz.q: Switching between Starter and Advanced…
a: Loses nothing — same data and lists, different toolkit
quiz.why: Your watchlist, portfolio and data are identical in both views — flip any time.

quiz.q: You're brand new. Which view should you start in, and why?
a: Advanced — more numbers means better decisions
Starter — fewer controls while you learn what each number means; Advanced is one tap away later
Neither — go straight to practice trading
quiz.why: Starter view hides the power tools until the basics are second nature. Nothing is lost — everything you learn still applies in Advanced.

title: 7 · Understanding the ratings
steps: If numbers make your eyes glaze over

Think of each rating as a fuel gauge, not a maths test. You never have to compute anything — the app does that. Your only job is to ask: is the gauge high, low, or changing? The steps below say what each gauge measures, in plain words. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 96' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><path d='M 60 78 A 46 46 0 0 1 152 78' fill='none' stroke='#54627f' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/><path d='M 60 78 A 46 46 0 0 1 106 32' fill='none' stroke='#f87171' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/><path d='M 106 32 A 46 46 0 0 1 138 45' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/><line x1='106' y1='78' x2='130' y2='46' stroke='#e8eef7' stroke-width='2.5'/><circle cx='106' cy='78' r='4' fill='#e8eef7'/><text x='52' y='92' fill='#f87171' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>low</text><text x='146' y='92' fill='#4ade80' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>high</text><text x='190' y='42' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>a fuel gauge,</text><text x='190' y='56' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>not a maths test:</text><text x='190' y='72' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>is it low, middling</text><text x='190' y='84' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>or high today?</text></svg>
Watch Score /10

The headline rating. Most of it comes from ACCUMULATION — days where price AND volume rose together (the footprint of steady buying) — blended with streaks and today's momentum. 7+ = Strong, 4–6.9 = Building, under 2 = Minimal.
Accumulation (10-day)

How many of the last 10 days closed UP on volume well above average. A high count is the classic 'quiet buying' pattern — but index funds buying look identical, so treat it as a flag, not proof. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 96' Volume Surge %

How far today's volume is above this share's normal. +100% = double. The colour shows direction: green = price up (buying), red = price down (selling). A big-volume FALL is heavy selling, not bullish.
Sharp Mover

Measures how abnormal today is FOR THAT SHARE: (today's move ÷ its typical move) × (today's volume ÷ its average). A calm share jumping hard on huge volume scores high. 📢 = likely news reason, 🔍 = no obvious reason yet. When the official ASX feed is reachable, the News column shows ✓ CONFIRMED announcements (with the real headline) instead of estimates.
Trading Range

Where the price sits in its recent band: 0% = at the floor, 100% = at the ceiling. 'Near low' is flagged for research — but a floor can bounce OR break, and end-of-day data can't tell which. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 88' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='14' y='30' width='292' height='22' rx='11' fill='rgba(58,74,122,.18)' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='18' y='24' fill='#f87171' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>floor 0%</text><text x='262' y='24' fill='#4ade80' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>ceiling 100%</text><circle cx='72' cy='41' r='6' fill='#f5c84c'/><text x='72' y='68' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='8.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>price now: near the floor</text><text x='160' y='84' fill='#54627f' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>a floor can BOUNCE or BREAK - the flag means research, not buy</text></svg>
See the full maths
Open 📖 Help guide and scroll to 'How the ratings & scores are calculated' for the exact formula behind every number.

quiz.q: A Watch Score of 8/10 means…
a: The share is guaranteed to rise
The quiet-buying patterns line up strongly — worth researching, never a buy signal
quiz.why: High score = 'worth a look', never 'good buy'. The score can't know WHY the patterns happened — that's your research.

quiz.q: Accumulation (10-day) counts…
a: Days that closed UP on volume well above average
quiz.why: It's the footprint of steady buying — though index funds buying look identical, so it's a flag, not proof.

quiz.q: A share shows Watch Score 8/10. What is that telling you?
a: Buy it — 8 out of 10 is a buy signal
Its price/volume patterns line up strongly — it EARNS a research look, nothing more
quiz.why: The score ranks how strongly the accumulation-style patterns line up. High score = interesting, research it. It is never a buy instruction.

title: 8 · Using the scans
steps: Instant Reports

The buttons under 'Instant Reports' each run a different lens over the data. They don't add magic — they just filter and rank what's already loaded. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='10' y='32' width='88' height='36' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='54' y='48' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>ALL the</text><text x='54' y='60' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>loaded shares</text><line x1='98' y1='42' x2='132' y2='30' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='126,26 134,30 126,34' fill='#8fa0c9'/><line x1='98' y1='50' x2='132' y2='50' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='126,46 134,50 126,54' fill='#8fa0c9'/><line x1='98' y1='58' x2='132' y2='70' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='126,66 134,70 126,74' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='136' y='16' width='170' height='20' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='221' y='29' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>accumulation lens → shortlist A</text><rect x='136' y='40' width='170' height='20' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#60a5fa' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='221' y='53' fill='#60a5fa' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>volume lens → shortlist B</text><rect x='136' y='64' width='170' height='20' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='221' y='77' fill='#4ade80' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>trend lens → shortlist C</text><text x='160' y='96' fill='#54627f' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>same data every time - a scan is a lens, not magic</text></svg>
Each scan starts clean

Running a scan or report automatically resets the view first — the previous scan's filters, search and messages are cleared — so you always get a fresh result and never a filter left 'stuck' from last time. If you want the full list back yourself, press Clear all filters.
Where Smart Money went

The old 🎯 Smart Money Scan (shares up several days on heavy volume) was retired: when we backtested its own recipe against real ASX history, the pattern predicted a WORSE next-5-day return — so it lost its button. 🎯 Best Evidence Today holds that slot now, built only from lines that earned a grade. The honesty machinery judges our features by the same rules as the market. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polyline points='14,66 62,58 110,48 158,36' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='2.2'/><circle cx='62' cy='58' r='3' fill='#4ade80'/><circle cx='110' cy='48' r='3' fill='#4ade80'/><circle cx='158' cy='36' r='3' fill='#4ade80'/><text x='14' y='22' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>up 2+ days in a row…</text><rect x='190' y='70' width='0' height='0' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f'/><rect x='190' y='74' width='13' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f'/><rect x='220' y='72' width='13' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f'/><rect x='250' y='60' width='13' height='26' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><rect x='280' y='56' width='13' height='30' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><line x1='184' y1='64' x2='312' y2='64' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/><text x='186' y='58' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>normal volume</text><text x='250' y='24' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>…on 50%+ extra</text><text x='160' y='98' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>both together = the Smart Money footprint</text></svg>
Top 20 to Watch

Twenty shares ranked by proven evidence first — a share carrying a graded signal sorts by that signal's edge — with the accumulation Watch Score ranking the rest. Tap any share code (the printer icon) to open its printable report. A quiet share with real evidence can sit above a lively share with none.
Market Today

📊 Market Today is a one-screen breadth snapshot: how many shares rose vs fell today, the strongest and weakest corners, and where the volume went. Use it BEFORE reading any single share — a share up 2% on a day the whole market surged means much less than the same rise on a flat day. It's a Starter-view card and an Advanced scan button.
Recovery Watch

↩️ Recovery Watch hunts the other direction: shares that have FALLEN for days but are now stabilising on elevated volume — the classic footprint of bargain-hunters stepping in. In Starter view it opens as a pop-up list; in Advanced it fills the main table so you can sort and filter the candidates. Reversals fail often — treat every hit as a research lead, never a signal to buy. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 100' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polyline points='10,20 50,34 90,50 130,64 170,72 210,74 250,73 300,71' fill='none' stroke='#f87171' stroke-width='2.2'/><polyline points='170,72 210,74 250,73 300,71' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='2.6'/><text x='14' y='14' fill='#f87171' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>fell for days…</text><text x='214' y='62' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>…now flattening</text><rect x='176' y='90' width='13' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#54627f'/><rect x='208' y='84' width='13' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#f5c84c'/><rect x='240' y='82' width='13' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#f5c84c'/><rect x='272' y='83' width='13' height='13' rx='1.5' fill='#f5c84c'/><text x='96' y='96' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>on elevated volume =</text><text x='96' y='86' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>someone catching the knife</text></svg>
🫧 Quiet Movers & 🪜 Pullback in Uptrend

Two calmer, patient scans. 🫧 Quiet Movers finds shares that barely moved today (−5% to +5%) but are quietly building underneath — a paused up-trend, heavy volume on a flat price, or a share that ran up then faded into the close. 🪜 Pullback in Uptrend finds shares in an established up-trend (above their key moving averages) that have dipped back to drift back toward their short-term average with momentum cooled but not broken — the classic buy-the-dip setup. 🕳 Gap Report finds shares that OPENED 3%+ away from yesterday's close and shows whether each HELD the jump or FADED it back — a description of the day (the ten-year check found no forward edge either way). 🧱 Strong Trends finds the full moving-average stack — price above the 20-day, above the 50-day, above the 200-day — ranked by trend quality. All are end-of-day estimates, never a signal to buy.
Volume Surge / Sharp Mover / Unusual Activity

Different angles on 'something unusual here'. Sharp Mover and Unusual Activity are the ones that surface out-of-character moves. All are estimates — click the 📰 news link to find out WHY something moved.
Always ask why
A scan tells you WHAT stood out, never WHY. The 'why' comes from the news and announcement links. Never act on a scan result alone.
Which scan for which job?

Want today's big picture? 📊 Market Today. Hunting graded evidence? 🎯 Best Evidence Today. One ranked shortlist? 🏆 Top 20. Chasing volume? 📈 Volume Surge. A dip in a strong trend? 📉 Pullback in Uptrend. Odd behaviour? 🔍 Unusual Activity. The sidebar groups them by job — ⚡ Act today vs 🧭 Build a view vs 📊 Compare & study — so pick by the question you're asking, not by habit.

quiz.q: What do the scans actually do?
a: Add secret data the table doesn't have
Filter and rank what's already loaded — different lenses on the same day
quiz.why: No magic — each scan is a different way of sorting the same honest end-of-day data.

quiz.q: A scan tells you WHAT stood out. The WHY comes from…
quiz.why: Never act on a scan alone — the story lives in the company's actual announcements.

quiz.q: You want shares in strong up-trends that have dipped back cheaply. Which scan?
quiz.why: Pullback in Uptrend finds shares above their key moving averages that have eased back to the 20-day line with RSI cooled — the classic 'buy the dip' research list.

title: 9 · Watchlists & your report
steps: Star shares

Tap the ☆ on any row to add a share to your watchlist. Manage lists with ⚙ Lists — create, rename, delete, and there's a ↩ Restore from backup button if a list ever goes missing. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 92' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='10' y='26' width='180' height='26' rx='5' fill='rgba(58,74,122,.15)' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='22' y='43' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='13' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>☆</text><text x='44' y='43' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>CODE</text><text x='86' y='43' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='9' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>price</text><text x='128' y='43' fill='#60a5fa' font-size='9' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>score</text><line x1='196' y1='39' x2='232' y2='39' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='226,35 234,39 226,43' fill='#f5c84c'/><rect x='236' y='18' width='74' height='48' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='273' y='36' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='8.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>⭐ your</text><text x='273' y='50' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='8.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>watchlist</text><text x='105' y='74' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>tap the star on any row - tap again to remove</text><text x='105' y='86' fill='#54627f' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>⚙ Lists manages, backs up and restores them</text></svg>
It follows the loaded market

Your watchlist shows only the shares from the exchange you've currently loaded — so viewing ASX shows your ASX shares, and it notes how many from other exchanges are hidden. Load a different market and those appear instead. One list can hold shares from several exchanges; you just see the relevant ones at a time.
Save My Report

Set the filters you like, then 💾 Save under ⭐ My Report. One tap returns to exactly that view any time. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 92' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='10' y='16' width='90' height='40' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='55' y='32' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>your filters</text><text x='55' y='46' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>set just right</text><line x1='100' y1='36' x2='132' y2='36' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='126,32 134,36 126,40' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='136' y='16' width='80' height='40' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='176' y='32' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>💾 Save</text><text x='176' y='46' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>My Report</text><line x1='216' y1='36' x2='248' y2='36' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='242,32 250,36 242,40' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='252' y='16' width='58' height='40' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='281' y='32' fill='#4ade80' font-size='8.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>⚡ auto</text><text x='281' y='46' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>every load</text><text x='160' y='78' fill='#54627f' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>one tap - or zero taps - back to exactly your view</text></svg>
Auto-run it
Turn on ⚡ Auto-run and your saved report applies automatically every load — you land straight on your report instead of setting it up each time.
Protect your data
On phones, browsers sometimes clear the app's storage. The app auto-backs-up and self-restores, but the sure fix is to INSTALL the app to your home screen — installed apps get durable storage.

quiz.q: Starring ⭐ a share…
a: Saves it to your watchlist, where it stays regardless of filters
quiz.why: The star is your 'keep an eye on this' — private, free, and it survives every filter and reload.

quiz.q: The trend chip on each watchlist share shows…
a: Whether it's been strengthening or weakening lately, plus the change since YOU starred it
quiz.why: ▲▲ to ▼▼ from its recent moves and averages — hover it and it explains itself in a sentence.

quiz.q: What does ⚡ Auto-run My Report do?
a: Applies your saved ⭐ My Report automatically every time data loads
quiz.why: Save your favourite filter set as ⭐ My Report, switch Auto-run on, and you land straight on YOUR view each morning — no taps.

title: 10 · Practice (paper) trading — the full course
steps: Why practice first — same decisions, zero cost

Paper trading is the real app, real end-of-day prices, real fees if you switch them on — with pretend money. Every mistake made here is one you don't pay for later. The goal isn't to 'win' with play money; it's to find out — cheaply — whether your rules actually make money before a single real dollar is at risk.
Your account & starting balance

Tap 💼 Portfolio to open your practice account. Use the 💰 'set starting balance' link to make the bankroll realistic — if you'd really trade with $5,000, practise with $5,000, so your return % is measured against the truth. If the account ever goes missing, the gold ↩ button restores it from the automatic backup.
Placing a buy — market vs limit

From any share: 💵 Practice buy. A MARKET order fills at the NEXT day's open — this is an end-of-day app, so that's the honest price you'd actually get, not today's stale close. A LIMIT order waits for your price: it fills only if the share trades at or below it, and expires if never touched. Cash is reserved while an order is pending. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 96' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><text x='12' y='14' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>you press Buy tonight…</text><rect x='10' y='22' width='130' height='30' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#3a4a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='75' y='36' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>TODAY (closed)</text><text x='75' y='47' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>market order placed</text><line x1='140' y1='37' x2='176' y2='37' stroke='#8fa0c9' stroke-width='1.5'/><polygon points='170,33 178,37 170,41' fill='#8fa0c9'/><rect x='180' y='22' width='130' height='30' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='245' y='36' fill='#4ade80' font-size='8' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>TOMORROW’S OPEN</text><text x='245' y='47' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>…is where it fills</text><text x='160' y='72' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>an end-of-day app fills at the NEXT open -</text><text x='160' y='84' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='8' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>the honest price you would really get, gaps and all</text></svg>
How much? Dollars, shares — and the $500 rule

Type a dollar amount or a share count. The form shows what slice of your account the buy is, and warns above 25% — concentration is how accounts get badly hurt. The ASX minimum first parcel is $500, and the app respects it. Small parcels carry a hidden cost too: a $19.90 round-trip of brokerage is 4% of a $500 trade — you start 4% behind. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 96' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='60' cy='48' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#54627f' stroke-width='10'/><path d='M 60 14 A 34 34 0 0 1 91 34' fill='none' stroke='#f5c84c' stroke-width='10'/><text x='60' y='52' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>account</text><text x='130' y='30' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>one buy = a SLICE,</text><text x='130' y='44' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='9.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>never the plate</text><text x='130' y='62' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>the form shows the % as you type;</text><text x='130' y='74' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>above 25% in one share it warns you -</text><text x='130' y='86' fill='#f87171' font-size='8' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>concentration is how accounts get broken</text></svg>
🎯 and 🛑 — decide the exit BEFORE you're in

Type a % (e.g. 15) and the price box fills itself — 15% above your buy; or type an exact price and the % updates. The 🎯 sells automatically into strength; the 🛑 caps the damage when you're wrong. Deciding both while you're calm — before money is in — is the single biggest upgrade over deciding while watching a red screen. If you've saved 📐 My Rules, both pre-fill automatically.
The trade note — 20 seconds that teaches the most

Write WHY you're buying: 'volume streak + breakout above 3-month range'. The note follows the trade into your holdings and history. In a month, sorting wins and losses by REASON shows which of your ideas actually make money — that feedback loop is the entire point of practising.
Realism switches: brokerage & honest fills

At the bottom of the portfolio, set a 💸 brokerage fee per trade — charged on every fill AND baked into each closed trade's P/L, so your stats never flatter you. Fills model reality: market buys at the next open, and a stop that gaps through fills at the open price — you don't get your stop price in a crash, and neither does anyone.
Watching positions — unrealised vs realised

Holdings show live P/L (unrealised — paper gains can vanish) separately from Realised (banked results of closed trades). The benchmark line compares your account against simply holding the index ETF — the honest question every trader must answer: am I beating 'do nothing'? <svg viewBox='0 0 320 96' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='10' y='18' width='146' height='62' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#60a5fa' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='83' y='34' fill='#60a5fa' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>HOLDINGS</text><text x='83' y='50' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>unrealised P/L</text><text x='83' y='64' fill='#54627f' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>paper gains -</text><text x='83' y='74' fill='#54627f' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>can still vanish</text><rect x='164' y='18' width='146' height='62' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='1.2'/><text x='237' y='34' fill='#4ade80' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>REALISED</text><text x='237' y='50' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>closed trades</text><text x='237' y='64' fill='#54627f' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>banked -</text><text x='237' y='74' fill='#54627f' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>this is your record</text></svg>
Selling — full, partial, and the ↩ undo

Sell the full position or just some shares (taking half off after a strong run is a real technique). If a stop or target auto-sold on bad data — a bad print, a corporate action — restore a 💾 export taken before it (keep occasional exports for exactly this), or export the account file and have it repaired. A ledger you can quietly edit isn't a ledger, so there is no delete button.
When the app sells for you

If the price reaches your 🎯 or falls to your 🛑, the position closes automatically at the honest price (gaps respected) and the history row is badged with what triggered it: 🎯 target · 🛑 stop — and with the advanced exits, 🪤 trailing or ⏱ time. Your 🔔 briefing reports it the same morning.
Your stats bar — the numbers that matter

Win rate alone lies (you can win 80% of the time and lose money). Read it with: average win % vs average loss % (are wins bigger than losses?), profit factor (total won ÷ total lost — above 1.5 is strong), expectancy (average result per trade — the one number that must be positive), and best/worst trade (is one lucky trade carrying everything?). <svg viewBox='0 0 320 104' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><text x='12' y='14' fill='#f87171' font-size='9' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>80% win rate… and still LOSING money:</text><rect x='14' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><rect x='38' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><rect x='62' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><rect x='86' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><rect x='110' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><rect x='134' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><rect x='158' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><rect x='182' y='38' width='16' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#4ade80'/><rect x='206' y='8' width='16' height='44' rx='1.5' fill='#f87171'/><rect x='230' y='12' width='16' height='40' rx='1.5' fill='#f87171'/><text x='12' y='68' fill='#4ade80' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>eight small wins</text><text x='212' y='68' fill='#f87171' font-size='8' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>two huge losses</text><text x='12' y='88' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='8.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>so read the pair: average win vs average loss,</text><text x='12' y='100' fill='#f5c84c' font-size='8.5' font-weight='700' text-anchor='start' font-family='sans-serif'>and profit factor - dollars won per dollar lost</text></svg>
⚙ Housekeeping
Each holding's ⚙ handles share consolidations/splits (so a 10:1 doesn't look like a 90% crash); 📝 adds notes later. Export a backup file occasionally — the account lives on this device.
The graduation rule

Only after 20+ practice trades with positive expectancy — including fees — does thinking about real money make sense. That's exactly what the 🤖 Bot Scoreboard measures for Auto-pilot too. Most people discover their first rule-set loses slowly; finding that out with pretend money is the cheapest education in finance.

quiz.q: You place a practice MARKET buy on Tuesday evening after the data loads. What price do you get?
a: Wednesday's OPENING price — the honest next chance anyone could actually buy
quiz.why: This is an end-of-day app: by the time you act on today's data the market is shut. Real people get the next open — so that's what your practice fill honestly models.

quiz.q: What does a LIMIT order at $2.40 do?
a: Buys immediately at $2.40 regardless of the market
Guarantees you $2.40 even if the price gaps to $2.20
Waits, and only fills if the share actually trades at $2.40 or less — expiring if never touched
quiz.why: A limit is a patient order: your price or nothing. Cash is reserved while it waits and returned if it expires.

quiz.q: Why set the 🛑 stop-loss BEFORE buying rather than 'deciding later'?
a: Calm-you makes better exit decisions than panicking-you; a pre-set stop caps the loss automatically
quiz.why: Every trader believes they'll 'just watch it'. The pre-committed stop is how losses stay small — decided while you were objective.

quiz.q: Your stats: win rate 75%, average win +4%, average loss −18%. Are you making money?
a: Almost certainly NOT — three +4% wins (+12%) don't cover one −18% loss; win rate without win/loss SIZE is meaningless
quiz.why: 3 wins × 4% = +12% against one −18% loss = net negative. Many small wins with occasional huge losses is the most common losing style — expectancy exposes it instantly.

quiz.q: A $500 parcel with $9.95 brokerage each way starts how far behind?
a: About 4% — the share must rise roughly 4% just to break even
quiz.why: $19.90 round-trip on $500 ≈ 4%. Fees are a percentage tax that shrinks as parcels grow — one reason tiny trades struggle.

title: 11 · My trading rules — write the plan once
steps: Why written rules beat willpower

Every losing pattern — chasing, oversizing, holding losers, panic-selling winners — happens in the emotional moment. A written rule-set is the calm version of you, consulted automatically at every decision. 📐 My Rules stores yours and wires them into the whole app: practice buys, the 🔔 briefing, and 🤖 Auto-pilot.
🎯 Today’s picks — the rules, applied for you

In ⭐ Start your day sits 🎯 Today’s picks: the same rules above, run on the server against the whole market each day. Shares priced $0.20–$0.99 that fired a signal your report card has GRADED as proven, scoring 7 or better, top four a day. Each card shows the price to buy under — a patient limit 2% below the last close, so you never chase — and where the trailing stop starts. 🛒 Practice buy opens the normal buy window with those numbers filled in; nothing is placed until you confirm, and every cap still applies. Two things to expect: an EMPTY day is normal, because four gates in a row often leave nothing and the list tells you which gate emptied it; and the second tab runs an older 15/15 rule set side by side as a deliberate comparison, not a recommendation, so that months from now the two can be judged on live results rather than on one backtest. A third lane now runs beside those two controls: with the bot ON, YOUR saved rules are mirrored to the server and decide their own nightly picks — your set, the trailing set and the 15/15 control judged forward from the same nights.
Why $0.20–$0.99 and not the whole market

Split five ways, the same rules got worse as price rose and went NEGATIVE above $5 — breakout and accumulation signals need room to move, and large stable companies do not provide it. This is the weakest part of the evidence: it is the band that suited these exits best over ONE window on ONE market, so treat it as best-available rather than proven. It gates what the BOT buys and never stops you buying anything yourself.
Three one-tap starting points

At the top of 📐 My Rules sit three ready-made sets. 🛡 Defender banks wins early (🎯15 🛑15 📦8% 🔢20 · no trail, break-even or hold · every gate on, day-jump 5). ⚖ All-rounder is the starter kit the Lessons teach — and what every NEW install begins on (🎯20 🛑15 📦10% 🔢20 · no trail, break-even or hold · gates on, day-jump 8). ⚡ Hunter is the different one — NO take-profit and no fixed stop at all, just a 🪤 20% trailing stop on shares priced $0.20–$0.99, RSI gate off because momentum traders deliberately buy strength. On the 13 August 2026 ten-year replay (real daily highs and lows, brokerage and 1% slippage included) it returned +232% against +97% for 🛡 Defender and +58% for ⚖ All-rounder at the same 2% dip entry — but every one of those figures comes from a test whose signal scores were computed across the whole period, so picks were filtered using information from their own future. When the same harness was re-graded honestly, window by window, roughly TWO IN THREE of its trades lost rather than one in two — expect a haircut of that size on any figure above. It is by far the hardest set to hold: most trades lose, every winner gives back 20% from its peak, and the profit arrives in a handful of trades you cannot pick in advance. Lesson 55 shows the whole correction. (was 🎯30 🛑10 📦15% 🔢5 🪤10 🛡+6 ⏱15). Since the presets went live, ONE tap does the whole job: it fills the form, SAVES it, and switches the bot on with the tested harness (best proven scan, the ladder, card-proven combos, score 7+, top 4 a day, 2% dip entry (deepened dips missed winners — re-set on the ten-year replay), the regime gate and 1% risk). You can still fine-tune anything and 💾 Save afterwards. Start on All-rounder, and let your Scoreboard — not your mood — argue you into another. <svg viewBox='0 0 320 96' style='max-width:340px;width:100%;display:block;margin:8px 0' font-family='sans-serif'>banks wins early</text><text x='57' y='58' fill='#8fa0c9' font-size='7.5' font-weight='400' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>hates drawdowns</text><text x='57'
